other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only and intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; minimal, local or non-invasive intervention may be indicated; may limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant but not immediately life-threatening; hospital care may be indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event and assess severity, intervention required and functional impact.

hypertension_grade.label: Hypertension grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No treatment-emergent hypertension.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Pre-hypertension range or transient mild elevation; no antihypertensive treatment indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Persistent or recurrent elevation requiring initiation or adjustment of one antihypertensive agent; generally 140–159/90–99 mmHg in adults.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe elevation requiring more than one drug or more intensive treatment; generally at least 160 systolic or 100 diastolic in adults.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences such as hypertensive crisis; urgent intervention required.

hypertension_grade.assessment_guidance: Use repeated, correctly measured blood pressure readings and record whether antihypertensive treatment or urgent intervention is required.

fistula_grade.label: Fistula grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No fistula. Use the anatomical site-specific CTCAE fistula term.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Symptomatic; non-invasive intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms; invasive intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

fistula_grade.assessment_guidance: Use the anatomical site-specific CTCAE fistula term; assess symptoms, need for invasive intervention and life-threatening consequences.

thromboembolic_event_grade.label: Thromboembolic event grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No thromboembolic event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Grade 1 is generally not used for clinically confirmed venous or arterial thromboembolism; use the specific CTCAE term.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Medical intervention such as anticoagulation is indicated without urgent instability.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Urgent medical intervention or hospital care is indicated.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening haemodynamic or neurological consequences; urgent intervention required.

thromboembolic_event_grade.assessment_guidance: Confirm the event and assess symptoms, need for anticoagulation or urgent intervention, hospitalisation, haemodynamic or neurological instability.

haemorrhage_grade.label: Haemorrhage grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No bleeding. Select the anatomical site-specific CTCAE haemorrhage term.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild bleeding for which intervention is not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate bleeding requiring medical treatment or minor intervention.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe bleeding requiring transfusion, invasive intervention or hospital care.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening bleeding with urgent intervention required.

haemorrhage_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade using the site-specific CTCAE haemorrhage term, intervention required, transfusion need, hospitalisation and haemodynamic consequences.

neuropathy_grade.label: Current clinician-verified neurotoxicity source grade
neuropathy_grade.source_grading_note: The NCCP table does not specify a grading edition or an exact recovery grade. Confirm a clinician-assigned source grade and documented recovery; do not silently convert to CTCAE v5/v6.
neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade 1: full scheduled vincristine if otherwise suitable; Grade 2: withhold until recovery then 50% dose; Grade 3–4: omit. Recovery and previous reduction require prescriber confirmation.

prior_vincristine_neurotoxicity_grade.label: Highest prior vincristine neurotoxicity source grade requiring modification
prior_vincristine_neurotoxicity_grade.source_grading_note: The NCCP table does not specify a grading edition or an exact recovery grade. Confirm a clinician-assigned source grade and documented recovery; do not silently convert to CTCAE v5/v6.
prior_vincristine_neurotoxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade 1: full scheduled vincristine if otherwise suitable; Grade 2: withhold until recovery then 50% dose; Grade 3–4: omit. Recovery and previous reduction require prescriber confirmation.

crcl_ml_min.label: Creatinine clearance (CrCl), exact result
crcl_ml_min.assessment_guidance: Use measured or locally validated calculated CrCl, not unadjusted eGFR. Preserve decimal values. NCCP cisplatin bands leave 49–50 and 59–60 gaps; seek review rather than round.
